name: JW Marriott Minneapolis Mall of America
positioning: Luxury hotel attached to Mall of America, between Minneapolis and St. Paul, with soaking tubs in every room, marble suite bathrooms and a 15th-floor Concierge Lounge
best_for: Shoppers and families who want to be directly connected to Mall of America
Travelers who want a JW Marriott base between Minneapolis and St. Paul

facts.text: The hotel is attached to Mall of America.
The hotel is located between the twin cities of Minneapolis and St. Paul, in an urban location with a suburban feel.
Mall of America has over 520 shops and 50 restaurants under one roof.
The hotel has second-floor skyway access to the mall.
Many guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and all have deluxe bedding.
Every guest room has a soaking tub.
The Presidential Suites include a full parlor with a spacious dining table.
The hotel has an indoor swimming pool.
The fitness studio is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
Cedar + Stone, Urban Table is inspired by Minnesota's natural surroundings and relationships with farmers within 200 miles.
Minnesota Valley National Wildlife Refuge is less than a mile from the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel is directly connected to Mall of America shopping, including brands like Nordstrom and Chanel.
Suites have Italian marble bathrooms with stand-alone tubs and separate marble showers.
The 15th-floor Concierge Lounge has views of the Twin Cities.
Arriving guests are met with an exclusive scent and sound created by Flamingo Estate for JW Marriott.
Babylon Micro-Farms at Cedar + Stone grow greens and herbs steps from the table.

considerations.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
Downtown Minneapolis is about 10 minutes away by light rail.
WhataHotel notes the mall location may feel commercial rather than like a traditional hotel.
